stem: In October 2026, 12 businesses started paying for Business Care, Voltmarkt's device-support subscription for small offices, at €40 a month. 9 of them had never subscribed before, and 3 had cancelled earlier in the year. In the same month 2 existing businesses moved from the €40 plan to the €65 plan. How much new-business MRR did October bring? Give euros with 2 decimals.
